gitCommit.subject: chore(purses-jz4): remove dead duplicate session-list + preferences routes (#201)
gitCommit.body:
chore(purses-jz4): remove dead duplicate session-list + preferences routes (#201)

All had zero callers (no client fetch, no server import, no e2e ref):
- DELETE flat GET /api/sessions (kept the live POST)
- DELETE nested /api/collections/[id]/sessions (GET+POST) + .../sessions/active
- DELETE flat /api/preferences/[collectionId] + nested /api/collections/[id]/preferences (base GET+DELETE)
- KEEP the live preferences children (items, recalculate) and the flat POST /api/sessions

Cascade: removed the methods these routes orphaned —
SessionController.listSessions/getActiveSession, PreferenceController +
PreferenceStateService getPreferenceSummary/clearPreferences. Deleted the
now-routeless session-list-authz + preferences-authz integration tests
(added in #200 to guard these routes); trimmed the flat sessions GET unit test.

Shrinks the surface g6o (DAL migration) must cover.

Gates: build, test:ci 278, lint 0 err, test:db 90; tsc shows only the 5
pre-existing errors (e2e specs + ScoringService.test.ts), no new.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
